name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2026-05-01, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 4.17 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
